description: Header file declaring bit manipulation functions for packing and unpacking bits and buffers in the ocudu::ocuduvec namespace.

methods.name: bit_unpack
methods.description: Unpacks an unsigned integer value into bits, or unpacks a bit buffer into bits.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits into an integer value or into a bit buffer.

methods.name: copy_offset
methods.description: Copies bits from one buffer to another, with specified offsets.
